fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2011 by approximately $39.2 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: Uses jet fuel option contracts or swap agreements and basis swaps to mitigate crack spread. During hurricane season (Aug-Oct) uses basis swaps on NYMEX Heating Oil indexes; historically ~45% of hurricane season requirements covered.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 121,030 [2011] 106,628 [2010] 13.5% [from 2011 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]
